From audition to the Final Cut🎬

In early 2024 I flew to London from Barcelona for the weekend intent on finding housing in those 48 hours (if you’ve ever lived in London you know how foolish I was to think that was possible.) 

Naturally, when you have the least amount of time is when you receive the most amount of work. Holed up in my Airbnb I blazed through the script and prepped my scenes after a day of demoralizing house hunting. I got up bright and early and ventured to a lovely self tape studio in North London, still completely unfamiliar in the city. As I made my way back on the tube, certain my little tape would go off into the ether never to be heard from again, I felt grateful for the work I got to do, in some stranger’s home, talking about acting and this bizarre, wonderful, painful, exciting and strange industry we’re in.

Now our little film is making its way to Canada! If you’re in Hamilton or Toronto come watch! You can find tickets through @castasidetheclouds
